recommendations.headline: Satisfied calls close at 72% versus just 16% for neutral calls (52% of all 2,200 calls), yet reps fail to ask for the order in 208 calls and give slow/unclear answers in 368, leaving 1,000 calls (45%) stuck at 'callback' instead of converting.
behaviour: Customers are overwhelmingly price-driven: price_enquiry is the top intent (752/2200, 34%), price_shopper is the top behaviour tag (379) and price_high is the #1 objection (308 calls).

Most calls stall rather than get rejected outright: 1,000 calls (45%) end as 'callback' and 346 as 'unclear', versus only 427 orders (19%) and 100 not_interested (4.5%) — customers delay more than they refuse.

Urgency is common but under-served: 294 calls are high-urgency and 230 customers are tagged urgent_buyer, yet delivery_time is the #3 objection (179 calls) and fast_delivery is the top unmet need (408 mentions).
Dealers drive volume and convert best (1,067 calls, 49% of total, 40% win rate) while the 'unknown' segment (790 calls, 36%) converts at only 25%, suggesting segment capture is inconsistent.
Technical questions are frequent and unresolved: needs_technical_help (325) and technical_advice need (362) rank high, matching recurring questions on gauge, thickness and weight per foot.
satisfaction: Satisfaction is the single strongest predictor of winning a sale: satisfied calls win 72%, neutral calls only 16%, dissatisfied calls just 6% — a 12x swing.
Only 35% of calls (765/2200) are rated satisfied while 52% (1,153) are merely neutral, meaning most calls aren't impressing customers enough to drive action.

Price is raised constantly but rarely resolved in-call: 70% of calls (1,539/2200) show 'price not discussed' even though price_enquiry is the top intent and price_high the top objection — a conversation gap.
When price is discussed, most customers negotiate (347) rather than reject (70) or accept outright (244), showing price is a discussion point, not an automatic dealbreaker.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order
conversion.evidence: Reps missed asking for the order in 208 calls; order_pct is only 19% while 1,000 calls (45%) sit at callback.
conversion.action: Train reps to end every price/product call with an explicit order ask or next-step commitment, especially for price_enquiry and product_info intents.

conversion.title: Lock in every follow-up
conversion.evidence: no_follow_up_fixed flagged in 344 calls; callback is the largest outcome bucket (1,000 calls, 45%).
conversion.action: Mandate a specific date/time for every callback, logged in CRM with a reminder; review unclosed callbacks weekly in team meetings.

conversion.title: Answer faster and more clearly
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer flagged in 368 calls; satisfied calls win 72% vs 16% for neutral.
conversion.action: Build a quick-reference rate/spec sheet (per thickness, brand, color) so reps answer instantly instead of saying 'I'll check and call back.'

conversion.title: Send written quotes immediately
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent flagged in 206 calls; many unconverted summaries show quotes promised via WhatsApp but never confirmed sent.
conversion.action: Standardize sending a written quote/screenshot within the call or within 1 hour for every price enquiry.

conversion.title: Always offer an alternative when unavailable
conversion.evidence: didnt_offer_alternative flagged in 121 calls; stock_availability is the #2 objection (298 calls, only 26% win).
conversion.action: Coach reps to propose the nearest available thickness/brand/color before ending the call instead of just 'will check.'

conversion.title: Capture customer segment early
conversion.evidence: Unknown segment (790 calls, 36%) converts at only 25% vs dealer segment's 40% (1,067 calls).
conversion.action: Add a quick segment-tagging question at call start (dealer/fabricator/contractor/builder/end-user) to route pitch and pricing appropriately.

conversion.title: Fast-track urgent and delivery-sensitive leads
conversion.evidence: 230 calls tagged urgent_buyer, 294 high-urgency calls, fast_delivery top need (408), delivery_time objection wins only 27%.
conversion.action: Flag high-urgency calls at intake and route to a priority dispatch/confirmation process with same-day callback.

offers.title: Express/priority dispatch for urgent orders
offers.for_whom: Urgent buyers and high-urgency callers (230 + 294 instances)
offers.why: fast_delivery is the top unmet need (408 mentions) and delivery_time objection appears in 179 calls.

offers.title: Instant rate card / WhatsApp price list
offers.why: price_enquiry is the top intent (752) and no_quote_sent was flagged in 206 calls.

offers.title: Cutting/processing add-on service
offers.why: cutting_processing need noted 92 times; multiple calls ask about lipping, bends and trimming.

offers.title: Advance stock booking for popular colors/sizes
offers.for_whom: Dealers and bulk buyers facing shortages
offers.why: stock_availability is the #2 objection (298 calls, only 26% win); several lost calls cite unavailable thickness/color.

offers.title: Consider a structured credit-period option for vetted dealers
offers.for_whom: Repeat dealers and needs_credit customers (85 instances)
offers.why: credit_terms objection has the highest win rate among objections (30%), suggesting formalizing it could convert more.

offers.title: Sample/shade-card service
offers.for_whom: Customers choosing colors for client projects
offers.why: samples need appears 58 times and many calls request shade photos or color cards.

loyalty.title: Recognize repeat and loyal customers
loyalty.how: Maintain a simple log/tiering for repeat_buyer (198) and loyal_to_us (17) customers, giving them priority handling and a known point of contact.
loyalty.why: Only 17 of 2,200 calls are tagged loyal_to_us, showing an under-leveraged base of 198 repeat buyers.

loyalty.title: Referral appreciation program
loyalty.how: Formally thank and prioritize customers who refer others, even without monetary discount.
loyalty.why: Referral behaviour is noted in only 26 calls — a small but valuable, under-nurtured channel.

loyalty.title: Dedicated contact for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign a single relationship point-of-contact for high-volume dealer accounts.
loyalty.why: Dealers are 49% of all calls (1,067) with the best win rate (40%); dedicated service can reduce the 368 'slow/unclear answer' misses.

loyalty.title: Proactive order/delivery status updates
loyalty.how: Send automatic WhatsApp/SMS updates at dispatch and delivery milestones without being asked.
loyalty.why: regular_updates is a stated need (180 mentions) and delivery_status is a top intent (205 calls).

loyalty.title: Free technical advisory line
loyalty.how: Offer a quick-access technical helpline for gauge/thickness/weight questions.
loyalty.why: needs_technical_help (325) and technical_advice need (362) are among the highest-ranked needs.

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor credibility
non_price_benefits.why: Customers frequently ask if JSW brand is included or about distributor status; this can counter quality_doubt (89) and competitor_cheaper (80) objections.

non_price_benefits.title: Wide product and brand range
non_price_benefits.why: Catalogue spans roofing sheets, Color On Plus, Pragathi, Radiance, GI, polycarbonate and more — useful to offer alternatives against the 298 stock_availability objections.

non_price_benefits.title: Strong technical expertise on specs
non_price_benefits.why: needs_technical_help appears in 325 calls; recurring questions on gauge, thickness and weight per foot show customers value guidance.

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable, trackable delivery
non_price_benefits.why: delivery_status is a top intent (205 calls) and fast_delivery is the top unmet need (408) — a fixed differentiator once execution improves.

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent supply assurance
non_price_benefits.why: consistent_supply (112) and stock_availability (397) are among the top stated needs.

non_price_benefits.title: Quality assurance and certification
non_price_benefits.why: quality_assurance need (116) and test_certificate need (16) plus quality_doubt objection (89) show customers want proof of quality.

top_questions.question: What is the rate for [product/thickness/color]?
top_questions.answer_tip: Quote a clear rate immediately and send a written quote on WhatsApp during the call rather than promising to check back.

top_questions.question: Is [specific color/thickness/brand] in stock?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give an honest stock answer and immediately suggest the nearest available alternative instead of leaving it open.

top_questions.question: When will the material/vehicle be delivered?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific date/time window and send a confirmation message; avoid vague terms like 'soon' or 'will check.'

top_questions.question: Has my payment/balance been received or confirmed?
top_questions.answer_tip: Proactively check and confirm payment status before the customer has to call back; set a clear time for confirmation.

top_questions.question: Can you give a discount or wholesale rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Reframe around value — authorised brand, consistent supply, technical support — and offer to review bulk/dealer-tier terms rather than negotiating ad hoc.

top_questions.question: Do you have a branch/delivery option in my area (e.g. Kerala, Salem, Theni)?
top_questions.answer_tip: Be upfront about serviceable zones and transport costs/timelines so expectations are set correctly.

top_questions.question: Can I get credit terms instead of full advance payment?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain current payment policy clearly and note that credit terms can be evaluated for established, regular dealers.

top_questions.question: Which gauge/thickness/brand suits my requirement (e.g. 47 vs 415, 0.47mm vs 0.50mm)?
top_questions.answer_tip: Use a simple comparison reference to recommend confidently instead of a slow back-and-forth.
